rate_schedule.note: DeepSeek splits billing into peak and off-peak from effective_at; off-peak is half the peak rate. Before effective_at the flat models rates below apply. A model absent from both maps here — every Gemini and Kimi entry — bills its flat rate around the clock. The windows are UTC because that is the clock DeepSeek bills on; at UTC+10 they fall at 11:00-14:00 and 16:00-20:00, which is most of an Australian working day. DeepSeek cut deepseek-flash's rates on 2026-09-10 when it replaced deepseek-v4-flash with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. deepseek-v4-pro's entry was dropped from this table when this harness stopped routing it. Verified against the live pricing page on 2026-09-11. docs/DESIGN.md section 4.9.

deepseek-flash.note: Pre-schedule flat rate inherited from deepseek-flash's predecessor, deepseek-v4-flash: deepseek-flash did not exist before rate_schedule.effective_at, so no request can actually price against this entry, but Table.Cost requires one regardless of the instant billed.

gemini-3.5-flash.note: Standard rates; 3.5 Flash has no introductory period. It is the dearest of the Gemini entries here — 3.7 Flash bills the same input and 2.4x less output — and is no longer the vision default.

gemini-3.6-flash.note: Introductory rates, in effect through 2026-12-31. From 2027-01-01 they double: 0.15 cache hit, 1.5 miss, 7.5 output. Nothing in internal/pricing watches that date.

gemini-3.7-flash.note: Introductory rates, in effect through 2026-12-31. From 2027-01-01 they double: 0.15 cache hit, 1.5 miss, 7.5 output. Nothing in internal/pricing watches that date. Priced identically to 3.6 Flash — the '50% cut' in the launch coverage is introductory-versus-standard, not 3.7-versus-3.6.

gemini-3.8-flash.note: Introductory rates, in effect through 2026-12-31. From 2027-01-01 they double: 0.15 cache hit, 1.5 miss, 7.5 output. Priced identically to 3.7 Flash and 3.6 Flash. Newest Flash model, released after the 2026-08-14 capture date of the other Gemini entries here.

claude-opus-5.note: Cache write is the 5-minute rate (1.25x base input); internal/anthropic never requests the 1-hour TTL ($10/MTok), so that rate has no entry here.

claude-sonnet-5.note: $2/$10 in/out is now Sonnet 5's standard price, not introductory — the scheduled 2026-09-01 increase to $3/$15 was cancelled. Cache write is the 5-minute rate (1.25x base input); internal/anthropic never requests the 1-hour TTL ($4/MTok), so that rate has no entry here.

claude-fable-5-1.note: Cache hit multiplier is 0.025x base input on Fable 5.1, not the standard 0.1x every other model in this table uses. Cache write is the 5-minute rate (1.25x base input); internal/anthropic never requests the 1-hour TTL ($20/MTok), so that rate has no entry here.
